summary_1line: Bhishma explains how the three gunas generate faults and rebirth, and that cultivating purity (Goodness) and destroying Passion and Darkness leads to liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: A luminous sage speaks to a listening king while a symbolic wheel of birth, desire, wrath, and sorrow turns behind them.
A soul curled within a dark womb surrounded by blood and shadow while faint chains of desire and anger bind it.
A radiant figure of pure light rises upward as shadowy figures labeled Passion and Darkness fall away beneath it.
